slices.title: Client fail-closed gate where media is really lost
slices.summary: Adds a pure client attachment policy that refuses each attachment the send path cannot deliver (unsupported type, too large, subscription route, Do images, too many images, ZDR) with a localized per-file reason before anything is sent, and replaces the silent drop on the subscription route with a thrown typed local error attachments_not_sent. No wire change.
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/features/chat/lib/attachment-policy.test.ts src/shared/api/chat-client.test.ts src/features/chat/lib/prepare-chat-attachments.test.ts && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint

slices.title: Server attachment contract
slices.summary: Adds a server-side AttachmentPolicy in model-gateway that validates every attachment with closed typed codes (media, size, count, route, encoding) before any model call, publishes the declared policy beside /v1/models, and raises the chat stream body limit to 12 MiB on the BFF and model-gateway hops. The subscription route refuses attachments instead of analysing them on the platform chain.
slices.needs_external: a developer stack with a subscription-pinned route configured for the typed-refusal capture (owner-held account)

slices.title: inference-core: image parts, vision filter, per-model flag
slices.summary: Adds the additive InferRequest.image_parts (tag 20, InferImagePart with message_index, data and mime_type, bytes only) and maps the indexed images into the OpenAI and Anthropic message bodies. Requests with image parts fail closed with typed vision_unsupported when no vision-capable provider serves the model, and a per-model vision flag with a denylist is advertised in list_models.
slices.needs_external: a live vision-capable provider deployment (Azure or OpenAI) with its credential for the two-image evidence
test_commands: git show HEAD:"apps/Model Plane/proto/model_plane/v1/inference.proto" (diff the field tag numbers against the working file and attach the diff; Appendix B N2 additivity proof)

slices.title: model-gateway: images as parts, remove the diversion, client catalogue gate
slices.summary: Behind CHAT_VISION_AS_PARTS_ENABLED (default off), an Ask turn with images goes to the picked vision-capable model with the images as image_parts on every tool round, instead of the vision-only AnalyzeImage diversion that drops history, tools and memory. Do turns with images are refused until S6, and the client gates image attachment by the model's declared vision capability.
slices.needs_external: live vision-capable routes (verevon-balance and an explicit Anthropic model) with provider credentials for the two-image evidence

slices.title: Read-only staging into code_interpreter (Ask loop)
slices.summary: Stages validated attachment bytes read-only under attachments/ inside the code_interpreter sandbox for the Ask loop, carried on a new ExecuteStepRequest.attachments (tag 12) and enforced by kernel read-only binds. A shared pure contracts module validates names and sha256, a request-scoped run-inputs registry is zeroed on release, and an unsandboxed host refuses staging. Behind CHAT_SANDBOX_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED (default off).
slices.flag: CHAT_SANDBOX_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED (model-gateway, opt-in, default off); execution-core honours the field unconditionally (inert when empty)
slices.needs_external: a live model route to drive the Ask turn that calls code_interpreter, and a Linux host with bwrap for the kernel negative-write proof
test_commands: git show HEAD:"apps/Model Plane/proto/model_plane/v1/execution.proto" (diff the field tag numbers against the working file and attach the diff; Appendix B N2 additivity proof)

slices.title: Do loop: attachments on RunAgentRequest, images in the Do seed
slices.summary: Adds repeated RunAttachment attachments = 20 to RunAgentRequest and carries validated attachments through the Do run: a sandbox note in the seed, images as image_parts on every InferRequest of the run, a run-scoped RunInputs guard released on terminal or cancel, and no inheritance by subagent children. Behind CHAT_DO_ATTACHMENTS_ENABLED (default off); checkpoints never hold attachment bytes.
slices.needs_external: the owner's approvals during a live Do run (plan and effectful-step approvals) and a provider credential
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --all-targets -p model-gateway
git show HEAD:"apps/Model Plane/proto/model_plane/v1/execution.proto" (diff the field tag numbers against the working file and attach the diff; Appendix B N2 additivity proof)

slices.title: Raise caps safely
slices.summary: Moves pending chat launch attachments out of sessionStorage data URLs into the in-memory store and IndexedDB (non-ZDR only), derives the browser, gateway, model-gateway and tonic body and decode limits from one max_total_bytes value, and lifts the imports-core extraction caps. The numeric limits wait for the OD18 ruling (DEC-37); until then the S2 server-declared constants stay at today's 1 MB.
slices.needs_external: the OD18 ruling (DEC-37) for the 4 MB xlsx/pptx/pdf numbers; the caps stay at today's 1 MB until it lands

slices.title: Durable reference uploads and OCR (outline, deferred)
slices.summary: Outline only and not scheduled: durable reference uploads through documents-api-go (not the text route as-is), a content hash per org, a deletion cascade to derived chunks, ZDR refusal, and local Tesseract OCR in imports-core. Reference attachments reuse RunAttachment with empty content and a signed reference resolved by execution-core through a Data Plane API.
slices.flag: per-org opt-in policy via the WS25 registry (no environment switch)
slices.needs_external: agreement of the Data Plane and Ingestion owners on the durable route, and the DEC-37 (OD18) ruling for the OCR engine and caps
